svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Release shaft: a coupling that fits the jack's release screw, a 12 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft out to the right front with two universal joints, then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: straight forward through the guard to a 60 mm knob outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lock disc: 80 mm dia x 6 mm on the shaft just behind the knob, with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one notch 12.5 wide x 15.5 deep, 120 degrees round from the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (check the angle against the jack you buy: open about 1/3 turn).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Post: 20 x 8 mm flat bar from 60 to 1,473 mm up, bolted to the right

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front strip frame, 330 mm right of the middle, with guide tabs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lock rod: 12 mm bar standing on the disc rim, a lift handle at 680 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and a 24 mm collar. Valve open: the rod drops 15 mm into the notch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gate slider: rides over the rod top when the gate is open; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: closing gate tongue pushes it back. Pin slider: blocks the collar

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: until the pin-presence plunger pulls it aside by its cable.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Result: the valve closes only with the gate shut and the pin home;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the valve closed the rod stands through the gate tongue.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Views: the lower end only; the upper end is in the gate joint picture.
